text.body: <1> kathāpātrāṇi puruṣapātrāṇi yaugandharāyaṇaḥ (unmattakaḥ) -- vatsarājasya mukhyamantrī| rumaṇvān (śramaṇakaḥ) -- vatsarājasya dvitīyamantrī| vidūṣakaḥ (vasantakaḥ) -- vatsarājasya mitram haṃsakaḥ -- vatsarājasya sevakaḥ| sālakaḥ -- yaugandharāyaṇasya anucaraḥ evaṃ sandeśavāhakaḥ| nirmuṇḍakaḥ -- yaugandharāyaṇasya bhṛtyaḥ| brāhmaṇaḥ -- yaugandharāyaṇasya mitram| bhaṭaḥ - gātrasevakaḥ - pradyotaḥ (mahāsenaḥ) -- ujjayinīrājāḥ| bharatarohakaḥ -- mahāsenasya pradhānamaṃtrī| bādarāyaṇaḥ - strīpātrāṇi aṅgāravatī -- mahāsenasya rāṇī| vijayā -- vatsarājasya pratīhārī| prathamo'ṅkaḥ (nāndyante tataḥ praviśati sūtradhāraḥ |) sūtradhāraḥ -- pātu vāsavadattāyo mahāseno'tivīryavān | vatsarājastu nāmnā saśa, śktiryaugandharāyaṇaḥ || (parikramya nepathyābhimukhamavalokya) ārye! itastāvat | (praviśya) naṭī -- ayya! iamhi | (ārya! iyamasmi |) sūtradhāra -- ārye! gīyatāṃ tāvat kiñcid vastu | tatastava gītaprasādite raṅge vayamapi prakaraṇamārabhāmahe| ārye! kimidaṃ cintyate | nanu gīyate | naṭī -- ajja mae siviṇe ññādikulassa assatthaṃ via diṭṭhaṃ | tā icchāmi ayyeṇa kusalaviññāṇaṇimittaṃ kañci purusaṃ pesiduṃ | (adya mayā svapne jñātikulasyāsvāsthyamiva dṛṣṭam | tadicchāmyāryeṇa kuśalavijñānanimittaṃ kañcit puruṣaṃ preṣayitum |) sūtradhāraḥ -- bāḍham | puruṣaṃ preṣayiṣyāmi vyaktamātmahite kṣamam | sūtradhāraḥ -- puruṣaṃ preṣayatyeṣa yathā yaugandharāyaṇaḥ || sūtradhāraḥ -- puruṣaṃ preṣayatyeva yathā yaugandharāyaṇaḥ || (niṣkrāntau |) iti sthāpanā (tataḥ praviśati yaugandharāyaṇaḥ sālakena saha |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- sālaka! sajjastvam | sālakaḥ -- ayya! aha iṃ| (ārya atha kim | ) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- mahān khalvadhvā gantavyaḥ | sālakaḥ -- mahattareṇa siṇeheṇa ayyaṃ uvaciṭṭhāmi | (mahattareṇa snehenāryamupatiṣṭhe |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- hanta yāsyati balavān yasya sauhārdam | kutaḥ, snigdheṣvāsajyaṃ karma yad duṣkaraṃ syād yo vā vijñātā satkṛtānāṃ guṇānām | krītaṃ sāmathryaṃ yasya tasya krameṇa daivaprāmāṇyād bhraśyate vardhate vā || 3 || atha veṇuvanāśriteṣu nāgavanaṃ śvaḥ prayātā svāmī prāgeva sambhāvayitavyaḥ| sālakaḥ -- ayya! leho khu maṃ obajjhai, jahiṃ āattaṃ kayyasarīraṃ | (ārya lekhaḥ khalu māmapakhati, yasmin āyattaṃ kāryaśarīram |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- vijaye! (praviśya) vijayā -- ayya iamhi | (ārya! iyamasmi|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- vijaye! tvaryatāṃ lekhaḥ pratisarā ca | vijayā -- ayya! taha| (niṣkrāntā|) (ārya! tathā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- atha dṛṣṭapūrvastvayaiṣa panthāḥ | sālakaḥ -- ṇahi, sudapuruvo| (nahi, śrutapūrvaḥ |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- etadapi medhāvilakṣaṇam| bhoḥ ! vanagajapracchāditaśaroraṃ nīlahastinamupanyasya pradyotaḥ svāminaṃ chalayitukāma iti pravṛttirupagatā naḥ| apīdānīṃ svāmino buddhyayatikramo na syāt | aho nu khalu vatsarājabhīrutvaṃ pradyotasya| vyaktīkṛtamasāmathryamakṣauhiṇyāḥ | kutaḥ, vyaktaṃ balaṃ bahu ca tasya na caikakārya saṃkhyātavīrapuruṣaṃ ca na cānuraktam | vyājaṃ tataḥ samabhinandati yuddhakāle sarvaṃ hi sainyamanurāgamṛte kalatram || 4 || (praviśya) vijayā -- leho khu aaṃ| paḍisarā savvavahūjaṇahatthādo tuvārīaditti bhaṭṭimādā āha| (lekhaḥ khalvayam| pratisarā sarvavadhūjanahastāt tvaryata iti bhartṛmātā āha) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- vijaye! vijñāpyatāṃ tatrabhavatyaisarvavadhūjanahastaprayuktā vā ekā vā pratisarā dīyatāmiti| vijayā -- ayya! taha | (niṣkrāntā |) ārya tathā|) (praviśya) nirmuṇḍakaḥ -- suhaṃ ayyassa | (sukhamāryasya) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathaṃ nirmuṇḍakaḥ | nirmuṇḍakaḥ -- ayya! eso bhaṭṭhipādamūlādo ovaṭṭhiio haṃsao āado| (ārya! eṣa bhartṛ pādamūlādaupasthitiko haṃsakaḥ āgataḥ |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathā haṃsaka ekaḥ prāpta iti| sālaka! viśramamyatāmidānīṃ muhūrtam| tvaritataraṃ vā yāsyasi saviśramo vā| sālakaḥ -- ayya! taha| (niṣkrāntaḥ |) (ārya! tathā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- svāmināvirahitapūrvo haṃsaka ekaḥ prāpta iti sāvignamiva me manaḥ| kutaḥ, yathā narasyākulabāndhavasya gatvānyadeśaṃ gṛhamāgatasya | tathā hi me samprati buddhiśaṅkā śroṣyāmi kinnu priyamapriyaṃ vā || 5 || (tataḥ praviśati haṃsako nirmuṇḍakaśca|) nirmuṇḍakaḥ -- edu edu ayyo| (etvetvārya|) haṃsakaḥ -- kahiṃ kahiṃ ayyo | (kutra kutrāryaḥ|) nirmuṇḍakaḥ -- eso ayyo| ciṭṭhai, uvasappadu ṇaṃ | (niṣkrāntaḥ|) eṣa āryastiṣṭhati upasarpatvenam|) haṃsakaḥ -- (upasṛtya) suhaṃ ayyasya | (sukhamāryasya|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- haṃsaka! na khalu gataḥ svāmī nāgavanam| haṃsakaḥ -- ayya! hijjo evva gado bhaṭṭā| (ārya! hya eva gato bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- hanta niṣphalamanupreṣaṇam | chalitāḥ smaḥ | athāsti pratyāśā athavā adyaiva prāṇā moktavyāḥ| haṃsakaṃ dharadi khu dāva bhaṭṭhā| (dharate khalu tāvad bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- dharate tāvadityanūrjitā vipattirabhihitā| gṛhītena svāminā bhavitavyaṃ nanu| haṃsakaḥ -- suṭṭhu ayyeṇa viññādaṃ| gahīdo bhaṭṭhā| (suṣṭhu āryeṇa vijñātam| gṛhīto bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathaṃ gṛhītaḥ svāmī| hanta bhoḥ! mahān khalu bhāraḥ pradyotasya bhāgyairnistīrṇaḥ| adyaprabhṛti vatsarājasacivānāṃ pratiṣṭhitamasāmathryamayaśaśca | idānīmanutpannakāryapaṇḍito rumaṇvān kva gataḥ| idānīmaśvārohaṇīyaṃ kva gatam| kutaḥ, snigdhaṃ ca sauhṛdahṛtaṃ ca kulodgataṃ ca vyāyamayogyapuruṣaṃ ca guṇārjitaṃ ca| krītaṃ parairgahanadurgatayā pranaṣṭaṃ yuddhe samastamatibhāratayā vipannam|| 6 || haṃsakaḥ -- jai samaggajohabalaparivāro bhave bhaṭṭhā, ṇa eso doso bhave| (yadi samagrayodhabalaparivāro bhaved bhartā, naiṣa doṣo bhavet|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathamasamagrayodhabalaparivāro nāma svāmī| haṃsakaḥ -- suṇādu ayyo| (śṛṇotvāryaḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- adhvaśrānto bhavān| āsyatām| haṃsakaḥ -- ayya! taha| (upaviśya) suṇādu ayyo| sāvasesapaccūsāe raaṇīe vāhaṇasuhāe velāe vāluatittheṇa ṇaiṃ ṇammadaṃ taria veṇuvaṇe kalattaṃ āvāsia chattamattaparicchadeṇa gajajūhavimajoggeṇa baleṇa maggamadaaṇīe vīhīe ṇāavaṇaṃ paādo bhaṭṭā | (ārya! tathā śṛṇotvāryaḥ | sāvaśeṣapratyūṣāyāṃ rajanyāṃ vāhanasukhāyāṃ velāyāṃ vālukātirthena nadīṃ narmadāṃ tītrvā veṇuvane kalatramāvāsya chatramātraparicchadena gajayūthavimardayogyena balena mārgamadanyā vīthyā nāgavanaṃ prayāto bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- tatastataḥ | haṃsakaḥ -- tado isakkhevamattotthide suyye ettiamattāṇi via joaṇāṇi gecchia kosamatteṇa via madaaṃdhīrapavvadaṃ aṇāsādia taḍāaṅkukkhittaṃ addhaṇimmidasilākammaṃ via visamadaṃsaṇaṃ diṭṭha ṇo ṇāajūhaṃ| (tata iṣukṣepamātrotthite sūrye iyanmātrāṇīva yojanāni gatvā krośamātreṇeva madagandhīraparvatamanāsādya taṭākapaṅkotkṣiptamardhanirmitaśilākarmeva viṣamadarśanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ no nāgayūtham|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado ṇijjhāantīsu seṇāsu samuppaṇṇasaṅkāpiṇḍide taïsma jūhe imassa aṇatthassa uppādao kocci padādī bhaṭṭāraṃ evvaṃ uvaṭṭhido| (tato nidhyāyantīṣu senāsu samutpannaśaṅkāpiṇḍite tasmin yūthe'syānarthasyotpādakaḥ kaścit padātiḥ bhartāramevopasthitaḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- tiṣṭha| itaḥ krośamātre mallikāsālapracchāditaśarīro nakhadantavarjamekanīlī hastī mayā ddaśyata ityuktavān nanu| haṃsakaḥ -- kahaṃ pariṇṇādaṃ khu edaṃ ayyeṇa| jāgatti khu samuppaṇo aaṃ doso| (kathaṃ parijñātaṃ khalvetadāryeṇa| jāgrati khalu samutpanno'yaṃ doṣaḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- haṃsaka! jāgrato'pi balavattaraḥ kṛtāntaḥ| tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado suvaṇṇasadappadāṇeṇa taṃ ṇisasaṃ paḍipūjia bhaṭṭiṇā uttaṃ atthi eso cakvavaṭṭī hatthī ṇīlakuvalaataṇū ṇāma hatthisikkhāe paṭhido| tā appamattā hoha tumhe imismi jūhe| gaaṃ taṃ ahaṃ vīṇādudīo āṇemitti| (tataḥ suvarṇaśatapradānena taṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ pratipūjya bhatrroktamastyeṣa cakravartī hastī nīlakuvalayatanurnāma hastiśikṣāyāṃ paṭhitaḥ| tad apramattā bhavata yūyamasmin yūthe| gajaṃ tamahaṃ vīṇādvitīya ānayāmīti|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- atha kathamupekṣitastadānīṃ svāmī rumaṇvatā| haṃsakaḥ -- ṇahi ṇahi| pasādia bhaṭṭā amacceṇa viṇṇāvido -- ṇahu de elāvaṇādīṇaṃ vi disāgaāṇaṃ gahaṇaṃ ṇa sambhāvaṇīaṃ| avidu durārakkhadāe āsaṇṇadosāṇi visaantarāṇi| tahiṃ ṇillajjo ṇirabhijaṇo paccantavāsī jaṇo| tā padādimattāhiṭṭhidaṃ imaṃ jūhaṃ karia savva evva gacchāmo, ṇa ekāiṇā sāmiṇā gantalāṃ tti| (nahi nahi| prasādya bhartāmātyena vijñāpitaḥ na khalu te airāvaṇādīnāmapi diggajānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na sambhāvanīyam| apitu durārakṣatayāsannadoṣāṇi viṣayāntarāṇi| tatra nirlajjo nirabhijanaḥ pratyantavāsī janaḥ| tat padātimātrādhiṣṭhitamidaṃ yūthaṃ kṛtvā sarva eva gacchāmaḥ, naikākinā svāminā gantavyamīti|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- api mahājanasamakṣamevamuktaḥ svāmī rumaṇvatā| evamapyavaktavyāṃ svāmibhaktimicchāmi| tatastattaḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado attajīvidaṇiddiṭṭheṇa savaheṇa ṇivāria amaccaṃ ṇīlabalāhaādo hatthiṇo odaria sundarapāḍalaṃ ṇāma assaṃ āluhia aṇaddhāgae suyye visadimattehi padādihi saha paādo bhaṭṭā| (tata ātmajīvitanirdiṣṭena śapathena nivāryāmātyaṃ nīlabalāhakād hastino'vatīrya sundarapāṭalaṃ nāmāśvamāruhyānardhāgate sūrye viṃśatimātraiḥ padātibhiḥ saha prayāto bhartā |) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- vijayāya| hā dhik, snehāt pūrvavṛttānto nāvekṣitaḥ| tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado diuṇaṃ via addhāṇaṃ gacchia sālalukkhacchāāe savaṇṇaṇaṭṭhaṇīladāe parubbhāsidehi asarīraviṇikkhittehi via dantajualehi sūido dhaṇusadamatteṇa via diṭṭho so divvavāraṇapaḍicchando| (tato dviguṇamivādhvānaṃ gatvā sālavṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ sāvaṇryanaṣṭanīlatayā prodbhāsitābhyamiśarīravinikṣiptābhyāmiva dantayugalābhyāṃ sūcito dhanuḥśatamātreṇeva dṛṣṭaḥ sa divyavāraṇapraticchandaḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- haṃsaka! asmatparitāpa ityucyatām| tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado bhaṭṭiṇā odaria assādo āamia devadāṇaṃ paṇāmaṃ kariagahīdā vīṇā| tado piṭṭhado ekkakidaṇiccao via mahanto kaṇṭhīravo samuppaṇṇo (tato bhatrrāvatīryāśvādāgamya devatānāṃ praṇāmaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītā vīṇā| tataḥ pṛṣṭhata ekakṛtaniścaya iva mahān kaṇṭhīravaḥ samutpannaḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kaṇṭhīrava iti| tatastataḥ | haṃsakaḥ -- tado kaṇṭhīravapariññāṇaṇimittaṃ parivuttā a vaaṃ| mahāmattottarāuhīāhiṭṭhido paccuggado so kidaahatthī (tataḥ kaṇṭhīravaparijñānanimittaṃ parivṛttāśca vayam| mahāmātrottarāyudhīyādhiṣṭhitaḥ pratyudgataḥ sa kṛtakahastī|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado ṇāmagottaggahaṇeṇa samassāsia kulavuttajaṇaṃ savvahā pajjodappaoo eso, aṇugacchaha maṃ, ahaṃ dāṇiṃ parassa uvaṇṇāsaṃ visamārambhaṃ parakkameṇa samīkaromi tti bhaṇia bhaṭṭā paviṭṭho evva taṃ parabalaṃ (tato nāmagotragrahaṇena samāśvāsya kulaputrajanaṃ sarvathā pradyotaprayoga eṣaḥ, anugacchata mām, ahamidānīṃ viṣamārambhaṃ parasyopanyāsaṃ parākrameṇa samīkaromīti bhaṇitvā bhartā praviṣṭa eva tat parabalam|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- praviṣṭa iti| athavā nanu sthāne, vrīlito vañcanāṃ prāpya mānī satvamupāśritaḥ| śūraścaikāyanasthaśca kimanyat pratipadyate || 5 tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado kīlāamāṇo via attacchandāṇuvattiṇā sundarapāḍaleṇa asseṇa attābhippāādo vi ahiaṃ paharanto adibahukadāe parabalassa adippaujjamāṇavāāmo visaṇṇāṇaṭṭhasavvaparijaṇo mae ekkāiṇā, ṇahi ṇahi bhaṭṭhiṇā evva rakkhiamāṇo aṇubaddhadivasajuddhaparissanto bahuppahāraṇipaḍiaturao tammāamāṇāsuythadāruṇāe velāe mohaṃ gado bhaṭṭhā| (tataḥ krīḍannivātmacchandānuvartinā sundarapāṭalenāśvenātmābhiprāyādapyadhikaṃ praharan atibahukatayā parabalasyātiprajyumānavyāyāmo viṣaṇṇanaṣṭasarvaparijano mayaikākinā, nahi nahi, bhatrraiva rakṣyamāṇo'nubaddhadivasayuddhapariśrānto bahuprahāranipatitaturagastāmyatsūryadāruṇāyāṃ velāyāṃ mohaṃ gato bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathaṃ mohamupagataḥ svāmī| tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- tado jahāsatti saṇṇihidagahaṇuppāḍidāhi aviṇṇaamāṇajādīhi kakkasāhi ladāhi pākido via sarīraantaṇādo paharisido bhaṭṭā| (tato yathāśakti sannihitagahanotpāṭitābhiravijñāya mānajātibhiḥ karkaśābhirlatābhiḥ prākṛta iva śarīrayantraṇāt pradharṣito bhartā|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kathaṃ pradharṣitaḥ svāmī| pīnāṃsasya vikṛṣṭaparvaṃmahato nāgendrahastākṛteśvāpāsphālikarasya dūrabharaṇād bāṇādhikāropiṇaḥ| viprābhyarcayituḥ -- śrameṣu suhṛdāṃ satkarturāliṅganainryastaṃ tasya bhujadvayasya, valayasthānāntare bandhanam|| atha kasyāṃ velāyāṃ pratyāgataprāṇaḥ svāmī| 8 haṃsakaḥ -- ayya! avasidāvalevesu pāvesu| (ārya! avasitāṃvalepeṣu pāpeṣu|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- diṣṭacā śarīraṃ gharṣitaṃ na tejaḥ| tatastataḥ haṃsakaḥ -- tado paccāadappāṇaṃ dāṇi bhaṭṭāraṃ pekkhia aṇeṇa mama hado aṇeṇa mama pidā aṇeṇa mama sudo mama vausso tti aññahā bhaṭṭhiṇīe parakkamaṃ vaṇṇauntā savvado abhiddudā de pāvā| tataḥ pratyagataprāṇamidānīṃ bhartāraṃ prekṣyānena mama bhrātā hato'nena mama pitānena mama sutaḥ to anena mama vayasya iti anyathā bhartuḥ parākramaṃ varṇayantaḥ sarvato'bhidrutāste pāpāḥ|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- tatastataḥ| haṃsakaḥ -- aṇṇaṃ ca dāṇi accariaṃ! aññāññaṇuṇaeṇa tarhi ekko vavasido akayyaṃ kattuṃ| so dakkhiṇāhimuhaṃ parivattia bhaṭṭāraṃ samaravāāmasaṃkhohidāṇi ṇiruvaāraṃ saṃkhivia kesāṇi pīḍia kareṇa karavālaṃ pahāravegaṃ uppādaidukāmo ādhāvanto (anyaccedānīmāscaryam| anyonyānunayena tatraiko vyavasito'kāryaṃ kartum| sa dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ parivatrya bhartāraṃ samakhyāyāmasaṃkṣobhitān nirupacāraṃ saṃkṣipya keśān pīḍayitvā kareṇa karavālaṃ prahāravegamuppā dayitukāma ādhāvana) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- haṃsaka! vṛttāntaṃ tāvadavadhāraya, yāvadahamucchvasāmi | haṃsakaḥ -- tado ṭhṭhuhiṭhṭhapaḍapicchiṭhṭhāe bhūmīe so ṇisaṃsao saeṇa veeṇa odhaṭṭidacaṇo paḍihadārambho hado paḍido| (tato rudhirapaṭalapicchilāyāṃ bhūmau sa nṛśaṃsaḥsvena vegenāvaghaṭṭitacaraṇaḥ pratigatārambho avaṇaaṇavibbhamadāe viruvantassa me vaaṇaṃ kocci ṇa suṇādi| aṃgho kiṃ bhaṇaha -- kiṇṇimittaṃ ussāraṇā vattadi tti| gahīdo ayyajoandharāano asidudīeṇa akkhohiṇīe aggavego muhuttaaṃ dhārido| vijayasundarassa hatthiṇo dantantacodido asī vivaṇṇo| asidośeṇa gahīdo, ṇa purusadoseṇa| (aṅgho bhartṛdārikāyā vāsavadattāyā apanayanavibhramatayā viruvato me vacanaṃ kaścinna śṛṇoti| aṅgho kiṃ bhaṇatha -- kinnimittamutsāraṇā vartata iti| gṛhīta āryayaugandharāyaṇaḥ| kiṃ bhaṇata -- kathaṃ gṛhīta iti| śṛṇvantvāryāḥ| āryayaugandharāyaṇenāsidvitīyenākṣauhiṇyā agravego muhūrtaṃ dhāritaḥ| vijayasundarasya hastino dantāntajodito'sirvipannaḥ| asidoṣeṇa gṛhīto, na puruṣadoṣeṇa|) prathamaḥ -- aṃgho appamattā hoha tumhe| pāāratoraṇavajjaṃ savvaṃ kosambī khu iaṃ| (aṅgho apramattā bhavata yūyam| prākaratoraṇavarjaṃ sarvaṃ kauśāmbī khalviyam|) ubhau -- odaradu oduradu ayyau odaradu| (avataratvavataratvāryo'vataratu|) (tataḥ praviśati yaugandharāyaṇaḥ baddhabāhuḥ phalakaśayanenānīyamānaḥ|) ayamahamavatarāmi| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- ripugatamapanīya vatsarājaṃ grahaṇamupetya raṇe svaśasradoṣāt| ayamahamapanītabhartṛduḥkho jitamiti rājakule sukhaṃ viśāmi|| 5 || utsarata|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- maddarśanābhilāṣī jano na kaścidutsārayitavyaḥ| paśyantu māṃ narapateḥ puruṣāḥ sasattvā rājānurāganiyamena vipadyamānam| ye prārthayanti ca manobhiramātyaśabdaṃ teṣāṃ nirodhamuktaḥ sa kila vanānyupalabhya bhadravatyā| grahaṇamupagamiṣyati prayāto nimiṣitamātragateṣu yojaneṣu|| 9 || bhadra! kathaṃ gṛhīta iti śrutam| bhaṭaḥ -- aṇusāria ṇalāgiriṇā gahīdo kila| (anusārya nalāgiriṇā gṛhītaḥ kila|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- asti vāhanasāmathryam| asamāyuktastu saḥ| gajasyādhoraṇāyukto javo bhavati śikṣayā| vimuktaṃ vatsarājena ka enaṃ vāhayiṣyati|| 10 || bhaṭaḥ -- ayya! amacco āha -- āuhāgāre ciṭṭhadu kila ayyo| purusaguto aaṃ desī tti| (ārya! amātya āha -- āyudhāgāre tiṣṭhatu kilāryaḥ| puruṣaguptoyaṃ deśa iti| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- aho hāsyamabhidhānam| aïgna baddhvā vatsarājābhidhānaṃ yasmin kāle sarvato rakṣitavyam| tasmin kāle suptamāsīdamātyairnote ratne bhājane ko nirodhaḥ || 11 || (parikramya) bhaṭaḥ -- idaṃ āhuhāgāraṃ| pavisadu ayyo| (idamāyudhāgāram| praviśatvāryaḥ|) (praviśya) bhaṭaḥ -- amacco āha -- avaṇīadu bandhaṇaṃ tti| (amātya āha -- apanīyatāṃ bandhanamiti|) yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- akṣīṇaṃ nāṃ kuru| vyaktaṃ bharatarohako māṃ draṣṭubhicchati| ahamapi tāvad bharatarohakaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi| madvākyaiḥ parikhidyamānahṛdayaṃ roṣāt pramattākṣaraiḥ prārabdheṣu nayacchaleṣu tulitaṃ tulyādhikārojjhitam| sūktaiḥ śāstrāviniścitairvirahitaṃ buddhyādhikaṃ vañcitaṃ draṣṭuṃ mallamapakriyāvinihataṃ vrīlādivādhomukham|| 12 || bharatarohakaḥ -- kvāsau kvāsau yaugandharāyaṇaḥ| avasitanijakāryaṃ vañcanairdurnirīkṣaṃ kathamiva paribhāṣe bharturarthe vipannam| ciramavanatakāryaṃ cāpi niryuktamantraṃ bhujagamiva saroṣaṃ gharṣitaṃ cocchritaṃ ca|| 13 || bhaṭaḥ -- ayyajoandharāaṇo ayyaṃ paḍivālaanto āuhāgāre ciṭṭhai| (āryayaugandharāyaṇa āryeṃ pratipālayan āyudhāgāre tiṣṭhati|) bharatarohakaḥ -- bhavatu bhavatu| mantritve vañcito hyeṣa savyājaṃ nīlahastinā| pratyādeṣṭuṃ sa tadvairaṃ māmidānīṃ pratīkṣate || 14 || bhaṭaḥ -- ayya! eso amacco| (ārya! eṣo'mātyaḥ|) bharatarohakaḥ -- (upagamya) bho yaugandharāyaṇa! yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- bhoḥ !| bhaṭaḥ -- aho sarassa gamambhīratā| ayyassa ekakkhareṇa pūrido ayaṃ deso| (aho svarasya gambhīratā| āryasyaikākṣareṇa pūrito'yaṃ deśaḥ) bharatarohakaḥ -- (upaviśya) bhoḥ!| yaugandharāyaṇa ityaśarīrāṇyakṣarāṇi śrūyante| diṣṭyā bhavān dṛśyate| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- diṣṭyā bhavān haśyata iti| paśyatu bhavān mām, evaṃ rudhiradigdhāṅgaṃ vairaṃ niyamamāsthitam| guroravajitaṃ hatvā śāntaṃ drauṇimiva sthitam|| 15 || bharatarohakaḥ -- aho chalenāgatagajārambhasyātmasambhāvanā| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kiṃ chaleneti| tat punaridānīṃ yuktam| yā sā mallikasālavṛkṣaracitā nāgāśritā vañcanā baddhaḥ sevitavān hi no narapatirbāhūpadhānāṃ kṣitim| rājño vāraṇanigrahe paricayād vīṇāśritā vañcanā pūrvaṃ prastutameva yāmi bhavatā naivāparādho mama|| 16 || bharatarohakaḥ -- bho yaugandharāyaṇa! yadagnisākṣikaṃ mahāsenasya duhitaraṃ śiṣyāṃ pratigṛhya adattāpanayanaṃ kṛtaṃ, yukteyaṃ bhostaskarapravṛttiḥ| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- mā mā bhavānevam| vivāhaḥ khalveṣa svāminaḥ| bharatānāṃ kule jāto vatsānāmūrjitaḥ patiḥ| akṛtvā dāranirdeśamupadeśaṃ kariṣyati|| 17 || bharatarohakaḥ -- adyāpi mahāsenena prayuktasatkāro vatsarājaḥ| tadidānīṃ kiṃ nāvekṣate| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- mā mā bhavānevam| yadasya cājñāṃ kurute nalāgiriḥ sa śikṣitānāṃ vacaneṣu tiṣṭhati| tato vimuktaḥ svaśarīrarakṣaṇe yaśaḥ pradātuṃ suhṛdāṃ ca jīvitam|| 18 || bharatarohakaḥ -- yadyevaṃ nalāgirigrahaṇārthaṃ vimuktaśced na punarbaddhaste svāmī| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- neti paśyatyupakrośabhayāt| bharatarohakaḥ -- aparokṣarājyavyavahāro bhavāniti bravīti| samarāvajiteṣu śatruṣu kimāha śāsram| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- vadhaḥ| bharatarohakaḥ -- vadhārho vatsarājaścet kimasmābhiḥ sa satkṛtaḥ| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- etadavekṣya khalu yadasya śarīraṃ nāpahṛtam| bharatarohakaḥ -- etadapi sambhāvya manyate svāmī| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- kaḥ saṃśayaḥ| hastaprāpto -- aho hāsyamabhidhānam | bhavatāṃ cāgrato yātaḥ śeṣakāryeṣu kā kathā| samūlaṃ vṛkṣamutpāṭya śākhāśchettuṃ kutaḥ śramaḥ || 20 || (praviśya) kāñcukīyaḥ -- (karṇe) evamiva| bharatarohakaḥ -- prakāśamucyatām| kāñcukīyaḥ -- kāraṇairbahubhiryuktaiḥ kāmaṃ nāpakṛtaṃ tvayā| guṇeṣu na tu me dveṣo bhṛṅgaraḥ pratigṛhyatām|| 21 || iti| yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- hā dhik| gṛhā na nirvānti mayā pradīpitā stathaiva tāvad hṛdayāni mantriṇām| iyaṃ tu pūjā mama daṇḍadhāriṇaḥ kṛtāparādhasya hi satkṛtirvadhaḥ || 22 || (nepathye hāhākāraḥ kriyate|) bharatarohakaḥ -- aye, ko nu khalveṣa sahasā prāsādāgrād viniḥ sṛtaḥ| śyenapakṣābhimṛṣṭānāṃ kurarīṇāmiva dhvaniḥ || 23 || kāñcukīyaḥ -- yadājñāpayatyāryaḥ| (niṣkramya praviśya) eṣā tatrabhavatyaṅgāravatī śokābhibhūtahṛdayā prāsādāccharīraṃ vimoktukāmā mahāsenenābhihitā yathā -- kṣatradharmeṇoddiṣṭaste duhiturvivāhaḥ| kimidānīṃ harṣakāle santapyase| taccitraphalakasthayorvatsarājavāsavadattayorvivāho'nuṣṭhīyatām iti| tatra hi, srījanenādya sahasā praharṣavyākulakramā| kriyate maṅgalākīrṇā sabāṣpā kautukakriyā|| 24 || yaugandharāyaṇaḥ -- evaṃ sambandhaṃ manyate mahāsenaḥ| tena hyānīyatāṃ bhṛṅgaraḥ| kāñcukīyaḥ -- gṛhyatām| (upanayati)
